title: C++: Ring Buffer
description: Implement a ring buffer (circular buffer) data structure.

steps.title: Ring Buffer
steps.description: Create a RingBuffer class with a fixed-size int array, head, tail. Implement bool push(int val) and bool pop(int& val). Test with 3 pushes and 2 pops.
hints: head = position to write, tail = position to read.
Full: (head + 1) % size == tail. Empty: head == tail.
